summary: Tested Creative Studio Nano Banana generation with object storage and role gating, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. This covers list + can_create for owner/lead, upload to storage, file serving, ?download=1 attachment, unknown token 404, and lead getting 403 on generate/upload/delete/import-brand-asset/expand-from-asset. It also covers generating with a storage-backed reference (n=2, source gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, reference_count=1, real image bytes), and owner delete with 404 on re-delete and on the file URL. Frontend: on Quick Poster, owner sees the builder and asset library; Generate added a new tile rendered from /api/marketing/creative/file/<token>; hover download and lightbox download hrefs carry ?download=1. Lead sees the view-only banner with no builder, upload, delete or expand controls; gallery images load, a real download works (creative-b86e4bf3.jpg) and the lightbox renders the image. One gap: the AI Director endpoints (build/refine/briefs delete/launch) are NOT role-gated, so lead can still generate Nano Banana posters through the AI Director tab.

critical.issue: No require_creator() check. lead@isodemo.com (staff) reached validation (400 'prompt is required' / 'brief_id and instruction are required', 404 'Brief not found') instead of 403. A view-only user can therefore generate Nano Banana images, and the posters land in marketing_creative_assets on launch, which breaks the 'only Owners/Managers/Master Admins generate' requirement. The frontend AI Director tab also shows 'Generate Campaign' to lead.

minor.issue: Brief docs still keep poster_data_url (base64) in Mongo (lines ~500, 611, 1013). Only the launched poster asset is moved into storage, so base64-in-Mongo remains for briefs.
Only the Mongo doc is deleted. Storage objects are orphaned (no storage delete). Acceptable if the storage API has no delete, but worth noting.
get_object failure (storage outage or missing object) is unhandled and would return 500, not a clean 404/502.

Docstring is stale: it mentions OpenAI gpt-image-1 and a placeholder fallback, but the code is Nano Banana only. Also, store_image runs outside the per-variant try, so a storage failure gives a 500 instead of the clean 502 message.

integration_issues.flow: Lead → Creative Studio → AI Director (default tab)
integration_issues.issue: Builder and Generate Campaign button are fully visible and usable for a view-only user. They need the same canCreate gating as Quick Poster.

issues: A leftover main-agent test asset 'legacy-test-1' (solid pink square, prompt 'legacy') shows in the iso-demo-org gallery. Delete it.

action_items: Add require_creator(user) to director/build, director/refine, DELETE director/briefs/{id}, briefs/{id}/launch (and probably churn-risk generate/approve). Hide the AI Director build UI for canCreate=false.
Store director brief posters in object storage instead of poster_data_url base64 in Mongo.
Delete test asset id 'legacy-test-1' from marketing_creative_assets.
Optional: wrap get_object in creative_file and store_image in generate with clean 404/502 errors; update the stale generate docstring.
critical_code_review_comments: Role gating is only applied to the creative.py endpoints and expand-from-asset. The director module, which also calls Nano Banana, is ungated.
can_create relies on user.role in {owner, manager, ...}. Make sure org managers whose platform role is 'staff' with a manager job_role are handled as intended.
The file token is a capability URL with no auth, served with nosniff + CSP. That is fine, but deleted assets' storage objects remain.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tested creative endpoints (9/9); director role-gate gap found
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; AI Director gating gap

seed_data_creation: None kept. Created 1 TEST_ upload (deleted via API) and 2 TEST_ generated assets (3 variants, deleted from Mongo).
